title: Show the lines that prove the answer
statement: When a question about a text is answered right or its answer is given, mark the lines in the text that prove the answer and bring them into view.
detail: The lesson engine's own lesson view, drawn in an animated version's markup, puts that build's margin line on the lines that prove the answer whenever a reply carries them, and brings them into view (`g9/transformer/web/lesson.js`). The blocks send those lines with a right answer, and with the answer given after the last try in the evidence hunt and the open check (`g9/transformer/src/mechanics/quick-check.js`, `g9/transformer/src/mechanics/evidence-hunt.js`, `g9/transformer/src/mechanics/open-check.js`). The rule has not been tried with readers.
against: The rule has not been tried with readers.
